description: This file defines the InsertHyperlinkDialog class, a UI component for inserting hyperlinks in a markdown editor within an Android application. It manages user input for hyperlinks, constructs markdown syntax, and communicates results back to the editor fragment.

classes.name: InsertHyperlinkDialog
classes.description: A dialog component for inputting a hyperlink and associated text, which constructs markdown syntax and sends it back to the editor fragment.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog, retrieving optional text argument.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI, listeners, and focus behavior based on existing text.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Factory method to create an InsertHyperlinkDialog instance with pre-filled text.
